description: Summary figure: pocket volume, catalytic geometry, residue mapping, ortholog conservation for KLB GH1-like domains
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib as mpl
mpl.rcParams.update({'font.size':9,'axes.spines.top':False,'axes.spines.right':False})
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1.15],hspace=0.42,wspace=0.3)

# A: pocket volumes
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
labels=['GBA3 active site\n(glucose removed)','KLB D1\n(5VAN apo)','KLB D2\n(5VAN apo)','KLB D2\n(5VAQ, peptide\nremoved)','KLB D2\n(5VAQ, FGF21CT\nbound)','a-Klotho KL1\n(5W21)','a-Klotho KL2\n(5W21)']
vals=[68.125,4.0,25.125,33.0,1.0,13.25,17.5]
cols=['#2a6f97','#b5651d','#b5651d','#b5651d','#7a4019','#6b705c','#6b705c']
b=ax.bar(range(len(vals)),vals,color=cols)
ax.axhline(68.125,ls='--',c='#2a6f97',lw=1)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(vals))); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,rotation=45,ha='right',fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel('buried cavity volume at catalytic centre ($\\AA^3$)')
ax.set_title('A  Sugar-sized space at the GH1 catalytic centre',loc='left',fontweight='bold')
for r,v in zip(b,vals): ax.text(r.get_x()+r.get_width()/2,v+1.5,f'{v:.0f}',ha='center',fontsize=8)

# B: catalytic pair distance
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
names=['GBA3\nE165-E373','KLB D1\nN241-E416','KLB D2\nE693-A889','a-Klotho KL1\nN239-E414','a-Klotho KL2\nE689-S872']
d=[4.89,6.67,6.45,7.16,4.37]
ax.bar(range(5),d,color=['#2a6f97','#b5651d','#b5651d','#6b705c','#6b705c'])
ax.axhspan(4.5,5.8,color='#2a6f97',alpha=0.12)
ax.text(4.4,5.15,'retaining GH1\nrange',fontsize=7,color='#2a6f97',ha='right')
ax.set_xticks(range(5)); ax.set_xticklabels(names,fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel('distance between the two catalytic positions ($\\AA$)')
ax.set_title('B  Geometry of the catalytic pair',loc='left',fontweight='bold')
for i,v in enumerate(d): ax.text(i,v+0.08,f'{v:.2f}',ha='center',fontsize=8)

# C: residue mapping heatmap
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
sites=['Q17','H120','N164','E165\nacid/base','Y309','E373\nnucleophile','W417','E424','W425']
rowsd={'LPH region IV':['Q1391','H1493','N1537','E1538','Y1683','E1749','W1792','E1799','W1800'],
       'LPH region III':['Q917','H1020','N1064','E1065','Y1209','E1273','W1316','E1323','W1324'],
       'KLB D1':['Q95','H195','H240','N241','G375','E416','W460','E467','W468'],
       'KLB D2':['K535','H648','N692','E693','F826','A889','F931','del','del'],
       'aKL KL1':['Q75','H193','D238','N239','G372','E414','W458','E465','W466'],
       'aKL KL2':['Q533','N644','N688','E689','Y809','S872','Y915','del','F917']}
ref=['Q','H','N','E','Y','E','W','E','W']
order=list(rowsd)
Mm=np.zeros((len(order),9))
for i,k in enumerate(order):
    for j,v in enumerate(rowsd[k]):
        Mm[i,j]= -1 if v=='del' else (1 if v[0]==ref[j] else 0)
ax.imshow(Mm,cmap=mpl.colors.ListedColormap(['#8d99ae','#c1121f','#2a9d8f']),vmin=-1,vmax=1,aspect='auto')
ax.set_xticks(range(9)); ax.set_xticklabels(sites,fontsize=7)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_yticklabels(order,fontsize=8)
for i,k in enumerate(order):
    for j,v in enumerate(rowsd[k]): ax.text(j,i,v,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=6.3,color='white')
ax.set_title('C  GH1 catalytic and glycone-binding positions (GBA3 numbering) mapped by alignment\ngreen = same residue as GBA3, red = substituted, grey = deleted',loc='left',fontweight='bold',fontsize=8.5)

# D: ortholog conservation
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
cons=[('Q95','D1',97.2),('H195','D1',100.0),('H240','D1',99.6),('N241','D1 acid/base',100.0),('G375','D1',99.6),
      ('E416','D1 nucleophile',100.0),('W460','D1',99.6),('E467','D1',99.6),('W468','D1',99.6),
      ('K535','D2',83.4),('H648','D2',31.1),('N692','D2',99.6),('E693','D2 acid/base',100.0),
      ('F826','D2',99.6),('A889','D2 nucleophile',94.3),('F931','D2',83.0)]
y=np.arange(len(cons))
colr=['#c1121f' if 'acid/base' in c[1] or 'nucleo' in c[1] else ('#b5651d' if c[1].startswith('D1') else '#2a6f97') for c in cons]
ax.barh(y,[c[2] for c in cons],color=colr)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f'{c[0]} ({c[1]})' for c in cons],fontsize=7)
ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlim(0,105); ax.set_xlabel('% of 283 vertebrate KLB orthologs with the human residue')
ax.set_title('D  Conservation of the pseudo-active-site positions',loc='left',fontweight='bold')
for i,c in enumerate(cons): ax.text(c[2]+1,i,f'{c[2]:.1f}',va='center',fontsize=6.5)
plt.show()
